message: The other day, I was cooking up a storm and my phone died right as I was about to check a recipe. I panicked for a second, but then I remembered my trusty smoke alarm was beeping away, reminding me to keep an eye on things. It made me think about how important it is to have a solid fire escape plan in place, just in case technology decides to take a vacation at the worst moment. So, how often do we check our smoke alarms? Just a little reminder to stay prepared, friends. 😊
